question: Does Godot's current reverse UID cache retain an old path after one UID moves to a new path, including when append-only cache history is replayed?

sources.title: Godot ResourceUID implementation
sources.claim: set_id, update_cache, and load_from_cache maintain forward and reverse UID mappings as modeled

distinguishing_outcomes: old_reverse is 123: current map operations retain the old alias
old_reverse is -1: the current implementation/model already removes stale reverse aliases
stop_condition: Record whether the old reverse path survives both set_id and replayed cache history, then prepare a target-native test if it does.
